text: Leave the dispatch bay and align with the source bench.
Stop at the bench and lower the open fingers around the outbound relay carton.
Close the two finger pads and establish a friction grasp.
Lift clear of the source and retract to the transport posture.
Carry the item through the cross aisle.
Dwell at the outbound barcode portal before continuing.
Dock at the receiving station and extend the arm.
Center the carton on the outbound shelf.
Open the fingers and let the item settle.
Retract the empty arm to the transport posture.
Drive to the parking bay and stop.
